description:
OBJECTIVE: Prove the new flow works as a whole before the 0.5.0 final prep depends on it. No repository changes are committed by this item (throwaway scratch worktree only), except fixes it finds, which become follow-up items.

REHEARSAL (scratch linked worktree from current origin/develop, deleted afterwards; nothing pushed):
 1. Conflict property: create two branches that each add a different changelog.d fragment, plus a third that mimics a prep; merge both into develop-equivalent in a BARE repo (git merge-tree --write-tree) and show no conflict; contrast with two branches editing the same CHANGELOG.md region.
 2. Authoring: make changelog-entry (user, breaking, internal) -> make changelog-check passes; hand-written invalid fragments fail with path-specific errors.
 3. Prep rehearsal: in the scratch worktree add representative fragments, run make release-prep VERSION=0.5.0 (final, folds [0.5.0rc1]) and VERSION=0.5.0rc2; inspect CHANGELOG.md: [Unreleased] empty, section placement, five headings, folded rc content verbatim, compare links per the rules, consumed fragments deleted, worksheet and coverage report printed; make release-check VERSION=<that version> reports only the expected curation findings (ceilings) and nothing structural; then curate to pass if feasible in the scratch tree.
 4. Tag-time gate: with a fragment present, release_flow check --pre-tag fails; without, passes.
 5. CI step: run the exact ci-paths command against synthetic title/changed-list/fragment combinations (feat without fragment -> fail; docs -> pass; revert -> pass; prep -> pass).
 6. Release-notes path: scripts/generate_changelog_entry.py --print-section --version <V> returns the compiled section for the GitHub release step.

DECISION GATES:
  G0 changelog-fragments-03 merged (04 may run in parallel in the tracker but is not required).
  G1 Any rehearsal failure is classified: defect in 01-03 (create a follow-up item with needs on this item, record evidence, do NOT silently patch in the scratch tree and call it done) or test-environment artifact (record). The batch is not complete while an unresolved defect item exists.
  G2 Live release check: report whether dlv2-52a/dlv2-52 state changed and whether the 0.5.0 final prep path is unblocked or still waiting on dlv2-22.

GUARDRAILS: scratch worktree only; never push, tag, open PRs, or touch release artifacts/rulesets/branches; remove the scratch worktree and any temp files after recording evidence; never run make release-cut or release-finalize; evidence goes in this item's context (concise commands and results), not in repository files or /tmp-only notes.
